sections.heading: Java PreparedStatement Interface
paragraphs: The PreparedStatement interface is an important part of JDBC used to execute parameterized SQL queries. It helps in improving performance and making database operations more secure.
In this chapter, you will learn about the PreparedStatement interface, why it is used, and how to create and use it in Java.

sections.heading: What is PreparedStatement Interface?
paragraphs: The PreparedStatement interface is a subinterface of Statement. It is used to execute parameterized queries, where values are passed at runtime.

sections.heading: Why Use PreparedStatement?
paragraphs: PreparedStatement is used to execute queries efficiently and securely by allowing dynamic values and improving performance:

• Improves Performance: The query is compiled only once, so execution becomes faster when used multiple times.
• More Secure: It helps prevent SQL injection by using parameters instead of direct values.
• Easy to Use: Values can be set dynamically using setter methods like setInt(), setString(), etc.

sections.heading: Methods of PreparedStatement interface
paragraphs: The important methods of PreparedStatement interface are given below:

Method | Description
public void setInt(int paramIndex, int value) | sets the integer value to the given parameter index.
public void setString(int paramIndex, String value) | sets the String value to the given parameter index.
public void setFloat(int paramIndex, float value) | sets the float value to the given parameter index.
public void setDouble(int paramIndex, double value) | sets the double value to the given parameter index.
public int executeUpdate() | executes the query. It is used for create, drop, insert, update, delete etc.
public ResultSet executeQuery() | executes the select query. It returns an instance of ResultSet.
